meta.title: QCS ranking updates correctly when a bid is submitted just before window closes
gaps: Waiting until exactly 1 second before the bidding end time
Having Vendor A submit through a separate vendor session at that precise time
Verifying that Master QCS updates immediately after that just-submitted bid
Using the specified bid values of price 95 and freight 5 to verify a landed price of 100
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Waiting until exactly 1 second before the bidding end time; Having Vendor A submit through a separate vendor session at that precise time; Verifying that Master QCS updates immediately after that just-submitted bid; Using the specified bid values of price 95 and freight 5 to verify a landed price of 100

steps.note: Open the prepared Master QCS screen for the existing bid state.
Verify that the submitted bid is represented by a real vendor column.
Verify that the available bid is ranked L1 in the QCS grid.
Verify that the QCS landed-price arithmetic and total are internally consistent for the available bid.
Verify that ranking follows the lowest landed amount among the bids present in this prepared state.
